notes: Genelec official 1237A page (https://www.genelec.com/1237a), exact model 1237A (product code 1237APM). Frequency response: 32 Hz–22 kHz at the -6 dB cutoff points (stored limits, same convention as the other Genelec records); 37 Hz–20 kHz within ±2.5 dB is also published. Amplifiers: 500 W bass (Class D) + 250 W midrange (Class D) + 200 W treble (Class AB); the stored 950 W is the sum of those three published ratings. Drivers: 305 mm (12 in) bass cone, 125 mm (5 in) midrange cone, 25 mm (1 in) metal-dome treble = 3 drivers; reflex-port MDF enclosure; 680 x 400 x 380 mm; 42 kg (a retailer listing that said 38 kg disagrees with Genelec and was not used); short-term max SPL >=118 dB. Active monitor: no sensitivity or passive impedance published. Genelec publishes a CLF simulation file for this exact model (https://assets.ctfassets.net/4zjnzn055a4v/ZtlepnTZComovfoo8azqQ/944ea7dd0fc0dbb15c82575a68908963/Genelec_Oy-1237A.CF2); it is NOT imported (see scripts/research/directivity-leads.json).
